skill_name: What are the most common elements found in the Earth's crust?
workflow: The most common elements found in the Earth's crust are oxygen, silicon, aluminum, iron, calcium, sodium, potassium and magnesium. These elements account for nearly 99% of the total mass of the Earth's crust and are the building blocks of all matter found on Earth. Oxygen is by far the most abundant element, making up 46.6% of the total mass. The other elements account for a total of 53.4%, with silicon the second most abundant element at 28%.
